title: Agent Configuration Lockfile
description: Resolved agentic configuration unit -- the 'package-lock.json' for an AI agent. Whereas an agent contract declares intent (like package.json), the lockfile records what was actually resolved and observed at run time: exact harness version, model pin discipline, goal hash, every tool with its version and permission surface, and the skills/prompts/policy in effect. provenance.config_sha256 -- the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization of this document with the 'provenance' object excluded -- is the stable identity of the configuration UNIT and is what Agentic Vulnerability Records (AVRs) reference.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the configuration was resolved/observed

agent.description: The deployed agent identity and its goal

goal.description: The agent's assigned objective. Cleartext goal text is stored by reference (ref) or hash (sha256), not inline, so lockfiles can circulate without disclosing proprietary instructions.

summary.description: Short public-safe description of the goal

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full goal/system-task text

ref.description: URI referencing the authoritative goal document

class.description: Goal category; vulnerability records can target a whole class

system_prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the resolved system prompt

harness.description: The agent harness -- the orchestrating runtime that owns the loop (e.g., an agent CLI, framework, or platform runner)

version.description: Exact resolved version string as reported by the harness

channel.description: Release channel the version came from

revision.description: VCS commit SHA or build revision, when the harness was built from source

purl.description: Package URL (purl) identifying the harness package, e.g. 'pkg:npm/...' or 'pkg:pypi/...'

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the effective harness configuration (settings file, flags, env-derived config) in canonical form

model.description: The reasoning engine. Hosted models have no stable 'version' in the package sense -- 'pin' declares which identity anchor applies, which determines what 'affected' matching can prove.

version.description: Resolved version or snapshot identifier, e.g. dated snapshot, deployment ID, or 'latest'

pin.description: Identity stability: weights = content-addressed open weights (weights_sha256 set); snapshot = dated provider snapshot; alias = mutable provider alias (e.g. '-latest'); floating = unknown/drifts

weights_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model weights file(s). Required when pin='weights'; the only form of model identity that cannot silently change.

endpoint.description: API endpoint/base URL the model was served from

parameters.description: Resolved inference parameters. Behavior-relevant settings belong in the unit because identical components under different parameters are different configurations.

tools.description: Every tool the agent can invoke, with version and permission surface. Exact versions AND schema_sha256 are required for CVE-grade matching: a tool's callable schema can mutate without its package version changing (tool poisoning).

name.description: Tool name as exposed to the model

purl.description: Package URL identifying the tool package

source_uri.description: Where the tool was obtained (registry, repo URL, path)

server.description: MCP/remote server backing the tool, when applicable

schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the tool's resolved input/output schema (canonical JSON). Detects silent tool-schema mutation at constant package version.

permissions.description: Granted permission surface -- the blast-radius fields vulnerability predicates match on

egress.description: Permitted network egress hosts/domains; empty = none, absent = unrestricted/unknown

commands.description: Allowlisted command patterns; empty means unrestricted when allowed=true

secrets.description: Names (not values) of secrets/credentials the tool can reach

skills.description: Resolved skills, prompts, plugins, and instruction packs in effect

policy.description: The guardrail/policy bundle enforced on this configuration

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the effective policy document

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization of this lockfile with the 'provenance' object excluded. THE vulnerability-unit identity: two deployments with the same config_sha256 are the same configuration.

transitive_tools_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical sorted list of tool (name, version, schema_sha256) triples; a coarser identity stable across unrelated field changes

attestations.description: Signatures or attestations over config_sha256 (in-toto, sigstore, etc.)
